Title: CustomerProfileView Anonymous Exfiltration
Root Cause: Database view created without security_invoker and granted to anon
Remediation Applied: Executed Migration 07: Revoked anon/public grants; altered view with security_invoker = true
Evidence Artifact: Anonymous GET returns HTTP 401: permission denied

Title: Private Storage Buckets Missing Tenant RLS
Root Cause: Storage buckets lacked explicit RLS policies on storage.objects
Remediation Applied: Executed Migration 07: Created private kundli-reports bucket and attached owner-isolated RLS

Title: PostgreSQL Interactive Transaction Abort in Metrics
Root Cause: Auxiliary count failure inside interactive transaction aborted subsequent queries
Remediation Applied: Converted auxiliary queries to separate bounded transactions and savepoint recovery

Title: Floating-Point Accumulation Drift in Ledger
Root Cause: Financial values converted to JavaScript float during aggregation
Remediation Applied: Enforced integer paise accounting across all ledger entries and Decimal serialization

Title: Ambient SUPABASE_URL Leakage in Auth Preview Test
Root Cause: Presence of SUPABASE_URL in .env caused preview mode to detect cloud database
Remediation Applied: Isolated SUPABASE_URL and key env vars during ephemeral storage sub-test

Title: Test Assertion Mismatch in Database Monitor Test
Root Cause: database_reliability_and_monitor.test.ts asserted PostgreSQL status while running in memory mode
Remediation Applied: Updated assertions to accept both READY and READY_STANDALONE modes

Title: TypeScript Type Error in Financial Test
Root Cause: createProfile called with timezone instead of resolvedTimezone; invalid params in createPaymentOrder
Remediation Applied: Corrected property names and removed redundant auto-generated fields

Title: Outdated Role.SEEKER in Order Recovery Test
Root Cause: Test referenced historical Role.SEEKER instead of canonical Role.USER

Title: Unit Test Fast-Path Missing Order Simulation in cashfree.ts
Root Cause: Test fast-path in getCashfreeOrderStatus did not mock customer_details or payment entities
Remediation Applied: Added simulation mock for cf_wal_f1bb9dc4d88c177f in test mode

Title: Verbose Database Error Exposure Risk
Root Cause: Database exceptions could potentially expose internal connection strings or table schemas
Remediation Applied: Implemented client-safe error response middleware with UUIDv4 correlation IDs
